name: @cyberluke/railgun
description: The fastest native TypeScript toolchain, one process, one traversal, no spray. railgun.exe: Q3-flavored one-pass type-aware lint+typecheck (Oxlint + tsgolint). railgun-pgo.exe: PGO-tuned hot loop. railgun-lld.exe: lld-linked twin. railgun-native.exe: target-cpu=native build. railgun-ts.exe: Go-native TypeScript 7 tsc backend (8-12x vs TS6; tsgolint 20-40x vs ESLint+typescript-eslint). Ships a migration pack (railgunize init) that rewires pnpm/turborepo workspaces into the native loop, installs a customized agent SKILL.md and updates AGENTS.md. Modifiers: -p|--project, --noEmit, --pretty, --max-diagnostics, --summary-only, --changed, --no-daemon; machine formats --agent/--json/--jsonl/--timings; named-pipe daemon with 300s idle. 59 errors | 120 warnings | 776 files | ~6s type-aware. IMPRESSIVE.
